description: This file is a Java source file implementing Hibernate-specific DAO operations for ProgramWorkflow entities within the OpenMRS platform. It contains method implementations for CRUD operations and complex queries related to programs, patient programs, states, workflows, and attributes, utilizing Hibernate ORM with criteria queries, HQL, and native SQL.

classes.name: HibernateProgramWorkflowDAO
classes.description: Implementation of ProgramWorkflowDAO interface utilizing Hibernate ORM for database operations related to ProgramWorkflow entities in OpenMRS.

methods.name: saveProgram
methods.description: Saves or updates a Program entity in the database.

methods.name: getProgram
methods.description: Retrieves a Program by its primary key ID.

methods.name: getAllPrograms
methods.description: Returns all Program entities, optionally including retired ones.

methods.name: getProgramsByName
methods.description: Finds Program entities matching the specified name, optionally including retired.

methods.name: findPrograms
methods.description: Searches for Programs with name matching a fragment, case-insensitive, ordered by name.

methods.name: savePatientProgram
methods.description: Saves or updates a PatientProgram entity with attribute handling.

methods.name: getPatientProgram
methods.description: Fetches a PatientProgram by its ID.

methods.name: getPatientPrograms
methods.description: Retrieves a list of PatientPrograms filtered by patient, program, date ranges, and void status.

methods.name: getPatientPrograms (by Cohort and Collection)
methods.description: Gets PatientPrograms for patients in a Cohort and optional set of programs, ordered by patient and enrollment date.

methods.name: saveConceptStateConversion
methods.description: Saves or updates a ConceptStateConversion record.

methods.name: getConceptStateConversion (by workflow and concept)
methods.description: Finds a ConceptStateConversion for specific ProgramWorkflow and Concept.

methods.name: getProgramsByConcept
methods.description: Finds all Programs associated with a specific Concept.

methods.name: getProgramWorkflowsByConcept
methods.description: Finds all ProgramWorkflows associated with a Concept.

methods.name: getProgramWorkflowStatesByConcept
methods.description: Finds all ProgramWorkflowStates associated with a Concept.

methods.name: getPatientProgramByAttributeNameAndValue
methods.description: Finds PatientPrograms matching attribute name and value.

methods.name: getPatientProgramAttributeByAttributeName
methods.description: Retrieves a map of patient IDs to attribute values filtered by attribute name.
